title: Codility Demo: Interactive Product Tours in 2 Minutes
text:
Take a 2-minute tour of Codility
Pick your role to see the tours made for you, then click through real Codility screens from setup to result.
Start here
Hiring with Codility for talent teams
From the invite in your applicant tracking system to an interview that starts from the candidate’s own code.
For talent teams · 10 steps
Hire engineers who build with AI
See how a candidate uses Claude Code or Codex and the AI Assistant, prompt by prompt, then interview them.
For engineering leaders · 9 steps
Codility Screen
Build an assessment from a job description, set AI per task, and review a report with full replay.
For talent partners · 11 steps
Codility Interview
Run a live interview in shared VS Code, with AI on or off and one scorecard for every interviewer.
For interviewers and hiring managers · 10 steps
Early careers hiring with Codility
Run one graduate program across every country, from the first invite to the season debrief.
For early careers teams · 9 steps
Cheating in technical hiring
Set integrity controls before the invite, then review every signal behind one risk rating.
For talent leaders · 8 steps
Codility Skills Intelligence
See which skills your engineers can demonstrate, by team and by skill, round after round.
For engineering leaders · 11 steps
AI skills assessment for business hiring
Give a candidate a real task to do with an AI Assistant, scored the same way every time.
For hiring managers · 10 steps
AI skills assessment for business teams
See which business teams already use AI well, and who to upskill next.
For learning and people leaders · 10 steps
What Codility released this summer
Click through what Codility shipped this summer, in one hire from the first task to the interview.
For talent teams and hiring managers · 15 steps
See Codility with your own roles and teams
Tell us who you hire and which teams you want to assess, and we’ll walk you through Codility set up for them.
